final_message:
DONE

I built the recovery plan workbook and a written summary. Only Scenario 3 ships May's PO on time, and it still misses the April date by 110 sets.

I couldn't recalculate the workbook formulas here because LibreOffice isn't installed. The daily allocations are computed in Python and the totals and cumulative columns are Excel formulas, so recalculate once when you open it.

The folder had no `workspace/` or `attachments/` content, only the PO listing and the task text, so the plan rests on the assignment text and that listing. The listing's open totals leave out the May row, so I used all nine rows. That gives 9,555 open sets (Crew Cab 5,520, Extended Cab 4,035).

| | Scn 1: current capacity, Grill Guard stays | Scn 2: current capacity, Grill Guard moved | Scn 3: 10-hour window, Grill Guard moved |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sets built by Apr 12 (need 8,080) | 6,090 | 7,305 | 7,970 |
| April PO in transit Apr 13? | No | No | Mostly: 465 of the last 575 Extended Cab sets are ready, the last 110 finish Apr 13 |
| Sets built by Apr 30 (need 9,555) | 7,305 | 8,925 | 9,555, with 35 to spare |
| May PO ships May 1? | **No** | **No** | **Yes** |
| All open POs complete | May 30 | May 7 | Apr 30 |

Scenario 3 has about a quarter of a day of slack, so one lost day puts May at risk. Its 30-day shift notice has to go out by Jan 5 for a Feb 5 start. I'd suggest a split April shipment with the customer.

**Assumptions:**
- **Grill Guard time:** you didn't give a rate, so I assumed the 100 units a week take one full cell-day a week, scheduled Fridays. Only Scenario 1 depends on this.
- **135/day upgrade:** I applied it from Feb 5 in all three scenarios, since it is already committed. At a flat 120/day, Scenario 1 would reach 6,600 sets by Apr 30 and Scenario 2 would reach 8,040.
- **Holidays:** no production on Louis Riel Day (Feb 19) or Good Friday (Mar 30).
- **Sequence:** I followed the customer's requested order. Output ships the next business day, so April must be complete Apr 12 and May Apr 30.

Each scenario sheet has the open-PO table with planned completion dates and a daily plan (planned sets per PO, cumulative totals, open balances). The summary doc has a section per scenario for Crew Cab, Extended Cab and Grill Guard, each with a verdict on May.

Files are in `outputs/`:
- Running_Board_Recovery_Plan.xlsx
- Running_Board_Recovery_Plan_Summary.docx
